# UPDATE Without the WHERE Clause

#### Course: Learn SQL Basics

## UPDATE Without the WHERE Clause

Now, let's see what happens when you omit the WHERE clause in an UPDATE statement.

Let's modify our previous query by removing the WHERE clause and simply changing the GPA:

```sql
1UPDATE Students
2SET GPA = 3.95;
```

In this case, every student's GPA in the Students table will be updated to 3.95 rather than just the intended student.

![Update all Rows](data:image/png;base64,)
